fee_details:
First-year fee: Rs. 0
Second-year onwards: Rs. 1000
joining_perks: A credit card that simplifies your business needs and rewards your spending, providing what the HDFC Bank Corporate Credit Card is. It not only provides you with access to MIS reports to help you make informed business decisions, but also provides you access to airports lounges across the globe.
reward_structure:
Earn 5 Reward Points per Rs. 150 spent
15x Reward Points on transactions made at selected merchants.
Reward Points are capped at 10,000 points per billing cycle.
key_highlights:
- 24x7 online Management Information System (MIS) availability.
- Minimization of paperwork and accounts reconciliation.
- Complimentary Priority Pass membership which gives you access to airport lounges across the globe.

benefits_features.Travel benefits: Complimentary Priority Pass gives you access to airport lounges across the globe. Up to 4 free visits to domestic lounges each year. Book flights and hotels via HDFC Bank Corporate Credit Card’s dedicated travel portal. Up to Rs. 1 cr insurance coverage for air and road travel.
benefits_features.Fuel benefits: Get a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions. Note: The fuel surcharge waiver is applicable only on fuel transactions between Rs. 400 and Rs. 10,000.
benefits_features.Lounge benefits: Complimentary Priority Pass gives you access to airport lounges across the globe. Up to 4 free visits to domestic lounges each year.

how_tos.Redeem Reward Points:
Login to https://credit.hdfcbank.net/RewardsLogin
Register your credit card if you have already registered your card proceed to the next step.
Select Redeem Reward Points, choose your card and proceed.
You will be redirected to the Reward Redemption portal.
Once again, select redeem points, pick your points, set the range, and choose a product or product from the rewards catalog.
Before you click check out, do a quick check of your address and other personal details. This is an important step since the product you redeem will all be sent to your registered address.
If your address or other details need to be updated, make sure you let us HDFC credit card customer care and have your details updated. You can proceed with redeeming your points once the change has been made.
Select, Redeem, and confirm your request. Do take note of the redemption number. You will need this number for all further communication you may have regarding that particular redemption. Alternatively, you can fill out the form for redemption and send it by post to
Rewards Helpdesk

miscellaneous: The credit limit on your card will be determined by the bank based on a number of factors such as the company’s profitability and the credit repayment history of the company as well.

faqs.What is the validity of the Reward Point: Your Reward Points are valid for five years from the date of accumulation. So, if you earn your points in July 2020, they will expire in July 2025.
faqs.Is there any cap on the Reward Points th: Yes. The Reward Points you can earn are capped at 10,000 points per statement cycle, and the 15x Reward Points are capped at 25,000 points per month. Insurance transactions have a cap of 2,000 Reward Points per transaction.
faqs.Is there a fuel surcharge waiver on this: Yes! The fuel surcharge waiver on this card is capped at Rs. 100 per billing cycle.
faqs.What is the interest-free period on this: You get to enjoy an interest-free credit period of up to 50 days.
faqs.What is each Reward Point earned on my H: Each Reward Point, when redeemed on the HDFC Bank Corporate Card website, is worth Rs 0.30 apiece.
